claim: By annual precipitation, 2022 was not especially dry compared with the record: it was 1.16 times the 1991–2020 baseline mean of 395.6 mm. Its 67-day longest dry run was nevertheless longer than the baseline median annual CDD of 46.0 days.
reason: Figures match the source: 2022 total 460.9 mm is 1.16x baseline mean 395.6 mm, rank 47 of 76 so not especially dry. Comparing a 67-day dry run to baseline annual CDD median of 46 days is a valid comparison, though CDD and longest run are defined similarly, so the claim is accurately stated.
